function.name: latest_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the latest exchange rate between two specified currencies.

source_currency.description: The currency you are converting from.

target_currency.description: The currency you are converting to.

amount.description: The amount to be converted. If omitted, default to exchange rate of 1 unit source currency
